verdict: ITERATE accepted as implementation conditions, not a native SDK repair
scope: Aside-only controlled local dashboard/iframe fixture; stronger fixture observation, not general native browser monitoring
native_capability_status: request and pageerror callbacks unavailable by real negative controls; must remain disclosed
requirements: Record actual methods before handling/rejecting every fixture request, including POST501 and route substitutions. Require non-vacuous identified document/iframe/JSON GET receipts; prevent caches/service-worker bypass.

Use complete fail-closed fixture CSP for resources/scripts/frames/workers/base/form/connect and redirects, with narrowly authorized early instrumentation. Unexpected frames/navigation/popups/instrumentation loss fail. Both negative-control origins must be test-owned loopback.
Keep original GET-only, pageErrors-empty and parent-outgoing-empty assertions intact. Add separate zero-CSP-violations guard. Never invent non-GET requests/errors for blocked attempts.

Install ErrorEvent, unhandledrejection, securitypolicyviolation and parent-message observation in both documents before production code, with readiness attestations and explicit event-collection barrier. Expected caught malformed/missing-map errors remain successful recovery cases.
Use unchanged production HTML/JS/CSS apart from declared fixture instrumentation/CSP and existing substitutions. All original modes/viewports retained; only new task-owned Aside tabs touched.
negative_controls: Actual same-origin POST must be logged and fail the original GET-only assertion, not just timeout.
Off-origin fetch POST and form attempt to second owned loopback origin must be blocked and fail separate CSP guard, not pretended HTTP observations.
Real uncaught async exception and unhandled rejection in both top document and iframe must reach original pageErrors assertion.
Actual parent→iframe message must reach original outgoing assertion; extension self-messages remain separately classified.
Missing observer/readiness/delivery or changed/extra document must fail closed.
acceptance: Independent code/security review plus real Aside negative-control receipts and unchanged53 positive/mutation cases; no PASS while any control or original case fails.
